description: Verify two scientific claims against real abstracts: one is supported, one is contradicted, and one paper is unrelated. Cite the evidence for each verdict.
task_prompt:
Two claims are under review.
Claim 1: Treatment with a protein named FN impairs regenerative abilities of aged muscles.
Claim 2: Chlamydia trachomatis is most prevalent in the UK among sexually-experienced individuals aged 16 to 24.
Using the papers in documents/, decide for each claim whether the evidence supports or contradicts it. Write each verdict on its own line as 'Claim N: SUPPORTED' or 'Claim N: CONTRADICTED'. For each verdict, cite the paper and the specific result behind it.

seeds.text: Chlamydia trachomatis is most prevalent in the UK among sexually-experienced individuals aged 16 to 24.
rationale: Prevalences in individuals aged 16-24 years were 3·1% (2·2-4·3) in women and 2·3% (1·5-3·4) in men.

seeds.text: Treatment with a protein named FN impairs regenerative abilities of aged muscles.
rationale: Deletion of the gene encoding FN from young regenerating muscles replicates the aging phenotype and leads to a loss of MuSC numbers.
Reconstitution of FN levels in the aged niche remobilizes stem cells and restores youth-like muscle regeneration.

claim_2_verdict.description: Claim 2 is supported by the evidence
claim_2_verdict.claim: Chlamydia trachomatis is most prevalent in the UK among sexually-experienced individuals aged 16 to 24.

claim_1_verdict.description: Claim 1 is contradicted by the evidence
claim_1_verdict.claim: Treatment with a protein named FN impairs regenerative abilities of aged muscles.

claim_2_flipped.description: Claim 2 called contradicted, but Paper B supports it

tool_result.alt_conclusion: Taken together, these results support the claim that treatment with a protein named FN impairs regenerative abilities of aged muscles.

conclusions.description: Both claims supported, erasing the contradiction
